name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
title: Strides Pharma Science Ltd - 532531 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Strides FY26 revenue up 6.4% to INR48.6bn with ex-US up 21% and EBITDA margin 19%, but US weakened, cash-to-cash cycle lengthened 7 days on 21 days higher inventory, and US growth pushed to H2 FY27.

utilisation.quote: we have got enough capacities to cover the next 2 years

capex.quote: the tangible portion is almost coming to an end from a fact we need only the maintenance capex

triggers.label: Inventory days up 21 YoY
triggers.quote: this increase is on account of higher inventory levels, which have increased by 21 days year-on-year

triggers.label: Intense competition in US molecules
triggers.quote: there has been intense competition in few of the molecules

triggers.label: Flu uptick did not materialise in H2
triggers.quote: the uptick which happens between the H2 and H1, what we have seen in the last 3 to 4 years did not happen in the current year

triggers.label: US FY28 aspiration held at $375-400M
triggers.quote: We continue to focus our aspiration of reaching $375 million to $400 million in the U.S.

guidance.quote: We continue to focus our aspiration of reaching $375 million to $400 million in the U.S.

guidance.value: 18% to 20% for next quarters; long-term upwards of 20%
guidance.quote: I have clearly said that margins will be between the 18% to 20% range.
we aim to reach EBITDA margins upwards of 20% and gross margins in the 58% to 60% range
it will be around INR300 crores is what I think
it will be upwards of $25 million, $20 million to $25 million for sure in the coming 2 years
we remain confident of improving our net debt to EBITDA ratio over the next few quarters

prior_guidance_check.quote: The performance during the year was impacted by a weaker flu season in the second half.
Last quarter, right, in Q4, we have grown at 11%.

red_flags.label: Cash-to-cash cycle up 7 days on inventory build
red_flags.quote: our cash-to-cash cycle is at 124 days, which is an increase of 7 days year-on-year

red_flags.label: Flu season shortfall; US growth deferred to H2 FY27
red_flags.quote: the growth should start from H2 onwards, with a higher trajectory

evasions.topic: Controlled substance quota and revenue potential
evasions.quote: we don't want to give a very specific revenue potential on controlled substances

evasions.topic: Market size for nasal spray pipeline
evasions.quote: We have not specifically -- this is beyond FY '25 strategy for us.
There are a lot of peer players
